channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dennis Smith | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dennis Smith from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Dennis Smith Jr.:

“He's a guy we're definitely looking at for the future...so far, so good with him.”

Dwane Casey on Dennis Smith, Feb 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Dennis Smith:

“He's getting in better basketball condition. I think that's showing in his lift, his dunk last night, and his jump shot.”

Dwane Casey on Dennis Smith, Feb 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose, Dennis Smith
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Dennis Smith Jr.:

“He's a versatile guard and he can get to where he wants to -- he's a lot like Derrick (Rose)...there's a lot of things we can use him in in our offense.”

Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose, Dennis Smith, Feb 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on his conversations with Dennis Smith so far:

“I told him it’s a clean slate of whatever reason he didn’t play in New York, or why Dallas traded him. I like guys with an edge and something to prove.”

Dwane Casey on Dennis Smith, Feb 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Pistons general manager Troy Weaver:

“We welcome Dennis Smith Jr. to the Pistons family. Adding another young player who was a high draft pick alongside a draft asset advances our goals in building for the future.”

Troy Weaver on Dennis Smith, Feb 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @JShawNBA.

item.title: Jalen Green on Stephen Curry, D'Angelo Russell, Dennis Smith
item.description:
Jalen Green:

“D-Lo [Russell] for sure. I can reach out to him anytime. That is like big brother. Steph [Curry], I used to work out with him. Dennis Smith. There are couple others, but those are the main guys I talk to.”

Jalen Green on Stephen Curry, D'Angelo Russell, Dennis Smith, Mar 19, 2020. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: David Fizdale on Dennis Smith
item.description:
David Fizdale believes the Knicks can still win the KP trade:

“Well, we don’t know what Dennis Smith is going to be. He’s 21. We’ve still got two first-round picks out of that. Who knows who that’s going to be? We won’t know exactly what comes out of that for a year or two.”

David Fizdale on Dennis Smith, Nov 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Mitchell Robinson on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Mitchell Robinson on his tribute tonight to teammate Dennis Smith Jr., who is away from the team while mourning the death of a close family member:

“Just letting Dennis know, you’re still with us no matter what. That’s my boy, that’s family.”

Mitchell Robinson on Dennis Smith, Oct 29, 2019. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Steve Mills on Reggie Bullock, Dennis Smith
item.description:
From Knicks President Steve Mills:

“Our Knicks family is deeply saddened by the sudden passing of Reggie Bullock and Dennis Smith Jr.’s close family members. At times like this, we are reminded that life is bigger than basketball. Our thoughts are with them and their families.”

Steve Mills on Reggie Bullock, Dennis Smith, Oct 29, 2019. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Julius Randle on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Marc Berman:Julius Randle on Dennis Smith's loss of stepmom:

“It’s life. Just because we’re bball players & make a lot of money & play a game we love, we don’t have real feelings and deal with real-life problems. It’s exact opposite as this situation proves. He’s going thru something real.”

Julius Randle on Dennis Smith, Oct 28, 2019. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Berman.

item.title: David Fizdale on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Ian Begley:David Fizdale on Dennis Smith Jr.:

“I want to put the ball in his hands a lot and get him out in the open court and get him a lot of space. Give him some freedom to make some mistakes ... The kid’s a talent and hopefully we can bring it out consistently.”

David Fizdale on Dennis Smith, Feb 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Carlisle:

“Dennis Smith has had a really terrific year and a half in terms of growth. I mean, he tops it off last night with a triple-double. He’s a tremendous young player,and New York is a such an exciting environment for a guy like him. It’ll be a great situation for him.”

Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith, Jan 31, 2019. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle:

“I see (Dennis Smith Jr.) as a starter and he and Luka needs to play together.”

Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith, Jan 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Statement from Rick Carlisle:

“I am excited to announce Dennis Smith Jr. will rejoin the team on Tuesday. Dennis and I spoke at length today. He is feeling better and plans to resume workouts in preparation for his return. There will be no further updates until Tuesday.”

Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith, Jan 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on DSJ (sprained right wrist):

“I'm not ruling Dennis Smith Jr. out from playing on this trip. But at this point I feel it is unlikely that he'll play in these three game. But he is making progress and he is doing better.”

Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith, Dec 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Dwain Price:Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith Jr., who missed Saturday's game against Boston with a sprained right wrist:

“He had a good day today, so I’m very encouraged. We’ll see how tomorrow goes, but things are looking very positive.”

Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith, Nov 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Dennis Smith
item.description:
“He's polished. He's skilled, and you can tell he's played professional basketball already. They got a great guy in him to lead this franchise in the future. Luka and Dennis [Smith Jr.] play well together.”

Kevin Durant on Dennis Smith, Nov 18, 2018. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Mavs owner Mark Cuban said.

“We wanted Dennis and Luka to take steps forward. Dennis has gotten better. Luka is still finding his way, but what a way to find your way. It was impressive.”

Mark Cuban on Dennis Smith, Oct 21, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Harrison Barnes on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Barnes:

“In this league, 26 is old now. I’m almost over the hill. Any advice I can pass on is great. I think we have a weird dynamic. I can be a veteran voice to Luka and Dennis and those guys. But Dirk on the other hand is almost 41, so I can also learn a lot from him as well.”

Harrison Barnes on Dennis Smith, Sep 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Dennis Smith
item.description:
For the Mavs, the really fun part will be watching the maturation of Doncic in the backcourt with point guard Dennis Smith Jr., who showed amazing grace and talent when he burst onto the scene as a rookie last year.

“Obviously we’re all really excited about Luka and him pairing up with Dennis,”

Donnie Nelson on Dennis Smith, Sep 18, 2018. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Harrison Barnes, South Africa, Dennis Smith
item.description:
Mavs president of basketball operations Donnie Nelson said.

“I’ve been to Africa on multiple occasions and it is a life-changing experience. I’m really excited that both Dennis and Harrison can have that opportunity.”

Donnie Nelson on Harrison Barnes, South Africa, Dennis Smith, Jul 28, 2018. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Mo Bamba on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Here's a snippet from UT's Mohamed Bamba on what he thinks of Dennis Smith Jr.:

“He's really good. And I believe I’m the type of big he wants to play with, who screens and rolls and can finish high above the rim.”

Mo Bamba on Dennis Smith, May 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith Jr.:

“Most rookies lose steam as the year goes on, but he's gained steam. He's become a real leader.”

Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith, Apr 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Dirk on Dennis Smith Jr.:

“He's 20 years old. His floor game is going to get better over the years, his decision-making is going to get better. But I love when he attacks. That's what he's meant to do in this league. He's fearless. He goes in there against anybody.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Dennis Smith, Mar 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith Jr. in the dunk contest:

“I have a feeling we’re going to see some things we’ve never seen before from a guy that’s 6-3.”

Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith, Feb 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Dennis Smith
item.description:
“Well, you know, the rookie season is tough, especially if you’re the point guard. There’s a lot of great players out there, and [Smith] is going to have a challenge every night,”

Dirk Nowitzki on Dennis Smith, Jan 13, 2018. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith Jr.'s 39 minutes:

“I thought he earned the minutes.... This is a game all of our young guys will learn from.”

Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith, Jan 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Bulls coachFred Hoiberg on Mavs rookie Dennis Smith Jr.:

“I absolutely love the kid. He’s as explosive as any point guard in the league.”

Fred Hoiberg on Dennis Smith, Jan 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Frank Ntilikina on Markelle Fultz, Dennis Smith
item.description:
As LeBron James so eloquently pointed out, Knicks president Phil Jackson bypassed Smith at No. 8 for Ntilikina, who is excelling most on defense.

“Me and Frank are actually cool,’’ Smith told The Post on Friday in New Orleans. “At the draft — I’ve been playing with a lot of those draft guys since middle school — but I probably talked to Frank more than anybody else other than Markelle Fultz, then at the rookie photo shoot, too. Frank and I are cool.”

Frank Ntilikina on Markelle Fultz, Dennis Smith, Dec 31, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rick Carlisle on @Dennis Smith:

“We drafted him because we think he can be a great player and one of the best players ever to play in a Mavericks uniform.”

Rick Carlisle on Dennis Smith, Dec 30, 2017. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.
